token.label: Bot token
token.hint: From @BotFather in Telegram: /newbot creates a bot, /token shows its token.

accessToken.label: Access token
accessToken.hint: A permanent system-user token of your Meta app with the WhatsApp messaging permission.

phoneNumberId.label: Phone number ID
phoneNumberId.hint: WhatsApp → API Setup in your Meta app dashboard.

appSecret.label: App secret
appSecret.hint: App settings → Basic in your Meta app; it proves every incoming message came from Meta.

verifyToken.label: Verify token
verifyToken.hint: Created for you; paste it into the webhook settings of your Meta app.

token.label: Bot token
token.hint: Developer Portal → your application → Bot → Reset Token. Turn on the Message Content intent there too.

applicationId.label: Application ID
applicationId.hint: Developer Portal → your application → General Information.

botToken.label: Bot token (xoxb-…)
botToken.hint: Your Slack app → OAuth & Permissions → Bot User OAuth Token.

signingSecret.label: Signing secret
signingSecret.hint: Your Slack app → Basic Information → App Credentials.

userToken.label: Admin user token (xoxp-…)
userToken.hint: Lets the bot delete messages. Installed by a workspace admin; without it the bot warns instead.

connections.title: Bot connections
connections.description: The bot accounts this application runs. Credentials are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
connections.remove-description: “{{label}}” stops receiving and answering messages at once. This cannot be undone.

hint.telegram: Add the bot to your group as an administrator with the right to delete messages and to ban users, so it can act on what it reads.
hint.whatsapp: Paste the webhook URL and the verify token below into the webhook settings of your Meta app, then subscribe to the messages field.
hint.discord: Invite the bot to your server with the permissions its actions need, and turn on the Message Content intent in the Developer Portal.
hint.slack: Paste the URL below as the Request URL under Event Subscriptions of your Slack app, subscribe to message events and add the bot to its channels.
hint.discord-invite: Invite the bot to a server
hint.discord-pending: The invite link appears once the application ID is known.
hint.after-save: Once saved, the connection shows the webhook URL and the values to paste into {{platform}}.

form.description: Paste the credentials the platform gave you. They are written once and never shown back.
form.label: Name
form.secret-keep: Saved — leave empty to keep it
form.generated: created for you when you save.

activity.title: Bot activity
activity.description: What the bot did, newest first. The list updates by itself.
activity.empty: The bot has not done anything yet.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.credentials-rejected: The platform rejected these credentials. Check them and try again.
errors.signature-rejected: The request could not be proven to come from the platform.
errors.transport-mismatch: Only a mock connection can receive simulated messages.
errors.unsupported-action: This platform, with these credentials, cannot do that.
errors.connection-disabled: This connection is switched off. Switch it on first.
errors.secret-missing: The server has no secret to protect bot credentials with. Ask its administrator to set one.
errors.credentials-unreadable: The saved credentials can no longer be read on this server. Enter them again.
errors.bot: The bot could not complete this.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
